description: Paris Wi-Fi - Sites disposant du service is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction des Systèmes d’Information et du Numérique - Ville de Paris. Liste des sites municipaux disposant d'un hotspot Paris Wi-Fi permettant une connexion à Internet limitée. L'accès au service internet Wi-Fi de la Ville de Paris est ouvert aux usagers dans la limite de la tranche horaire de 7h à minuit.. Les connexions sont limités à 2h, sans limitation de reconnexion. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Equipements, Services, Social. Its keywords are wifi, internet, Paris Wi-Fi. The portal shows 314 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
